posts.text: Was reviewing last one year of activities in Manappuram. Post Q1FY26, it was available at a valuation of 1.8 times Price to Book Value. Post Q1FY27, it is available at a valuation of 2.0 times Price to Book Value → Seems a fair valuation, neither under-valued, nor over-valued. Expected Book value by Q4FY27 to be around 193-195, considering 14%-15% yearly ROE → Reasonable compounding. If Bain appointed Management able to get better NIM and ROA, with expansion in AUM supported by increased branch network, quite possible ROE can jump to 18% → Which may excite DII’s to switch from Muthoot to Manap…
